overview.title: Your family
overview.emptyBody: Ask your family member for the link code in their Kneedit Profile, then link to them.

link.title: Link a family member
link.body: Ask your family member for the 6-character code in their Kneedit Profile, under Family and physiotherapist.

pending.title: Request sent
pending.body: Your family member needs to approve it. In Kneedit, they open Profile, then Family and physiotherapist.
pending.private: Until they approve, you see nothing about them.
